claims.text: The selected sharing layer is trained using a sifted multi-task learning method that incorporates a gated sharing cell and an attention sharing cell to filter and select shared features for specific tasks.
The training involves a global loss function that minimizes the cross-entropy of predictions across tasks, with specific weights assigned to each task.
